title: The Drake Menace / Drake Matriarch
summary: Destroy the drake eggs and prepare for the matriarch's retaliation.
overview: Destroy the drake eggs and prepare for the matriarch's retaliation.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Clear drakes and keep watch for the mission's egg progression.
Expect additional drakes as eggs are destroyed.
Destroying the fifteenth egg calls the Drake Matriarch; prepare the group before breaking the last egg.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 5.
